set.body:
Scope
Compile f(W) plus a vector of g_i(T_i W) terms without silently collapsing penalties.

Acceptance criteria
- Executes L1 plus graph-Laplacian smoothness, L1 plus derivative/spline smoothness, L1 plus TV, sparse-group plus smoothness, and per-block variants.
- Direct proximal lowering is admitted only when the combined prox is proved exact; otherwise operators are stacked into a certified split/primal-dual program.
- Lipschitz and operator-norm bounds are derived or provenance-bearing and checked.
- Indefinite smoothing, false bounds, incompatible charts, and unsupported prox sums are rejected.
- Objective decomposition, KKT residuals, feasibility, and primal-dual gap are independently recomputed.
- Analytic 1D/2D, differential convex-oracle, permutation, nullspace, and extreme-penalty tests pass on JVM and JS.
- Hot loops remain allocation-disciplined and do not densify sparse operators.
set.title: Multivar math 2: exact composite sparse-smooth penalty compiler
